teaser.en: This riverside giant carries the name of a spirit, and healers turn to it for the illnesses that spirit is said to cause.
teaser.sw: Jitu hili la kando ya mito linabeba jina la pepo, na waganga hulitegemea kutibu maradhi yanayosemekana kusababishwa na pepo huyo.

summary.en: *Mwanga* is the river terminalia, a large tree of the coastal and riverine forests. The Digo name it after the spirit Mwanga and use it to treat the illnesses attributed to that spirit.
summary.sw: *Mwanga* ni mti mkubwa wa jenasi ya *Terminalia* unaoota kando ya mito (kwa Kiingereza *river terminalia*), katika misitu ya pwani na ya kando ya mito. Wadigo wameupa jina la pepo Mwanga, na huutumia kutibu maradhi yanayohusishwa na pepo huyo.

about.en: *Mwanga* is a large forest tree. Its leaves grow bunched together at the ends of the branches, a habit typical of the Terminalia genus. The fruits are flat and papery, with two wings, and they hang in clusters that are easy to spot even when the leaves are high up.
about.sw: *Mwanga* ni mti mkubwa wa msituni. Majani yake huota yakiwa yamejikusanya kwenye ncha za matawi, tabia ya kawaida ya jenasi ya *Terminalia*. Matunda yake ni bapa na membamba kama karatasi, yenye mabawa mawili, na huning'inia kwa vishada ambavyo huonekana kwa urahisi hata majani yakiwa juu sana.

where.en: It grows in coastal forest and along rivers, where the soil stays moist. Look for it in riverine strips and forest patches inland from the shore.
where.sw: Huota katika misitu ya pwani na kando ya mito, mahali ambapo udongo hubaki na unyevu. Utautafuta katika vipande vya msitu vilivyo kando ya mito na katika visiwa vya msitu vilivyo bara, mbali kidogo na ufuo.

uses.en: Its main recorded use is as medicine. It is used to treat illness that is believed to come from the spirit Mwanga.
uses.sw: Matumizi yake makuu yaliyorekodiwa ni dawa. Hutumika kutibu maradhi yanayoaminika kuletwa na pepo Mwanga.

culture.en: The tree is named after Mwanga, a spirit, and its medicine is used against ailments caused by that same spirit: the name and the cure go together. Mwanga also appears in the name of *mwangajine*, a forest tree named after two spirits, Mwanga and Jine, which shows how closely Digo plant names can follow the spirit world.
culture.sw: Mti huu umepewa jina la Mwanga, pepo, na dawa yake hutumika dhidi ya maradhi yanayosababishwa na pepo huyo huyo: jina na tiba vinakwenda pamoja. Mwanga pia anaonekana katika jina la *mwangajine*, mti wa msituni uliopewa jina la pepo wawili, Mwanga na Jine, jambo linaloonyesha jinsi majina ya mimea ya Kidigo yanavyoweza kufuata kwa karibu ulimwengu wa pepo.

names.en: The name *mwanga* is shared across Digo, Duruma, Giriama and Swahili. In English it is the river terminalia. Note that *mwanga* is also used in Digo for the spiny terminalia, which is more fully called *mwanga kululu*.
names.sw: Jina *mwanga* linatumika kwa pamoja katika Kidigo, Kiduruma, Kigiriama na Kiswahili. Kwa Kiingereza unaitwa *river terminalia*. Ikumbukwe kwamba katika Kidigo *mwanga* hutumika pia kwa *Terminalia* yenye miiba (*spiny terminalia*), ambayo kwa ukamilifu huitwa *mwanga kululu*.

reason.en: Spiny terminalia, same genus and same short name
reason.sw: *Terminalia* yenye miiba, jenasi moja na jina fupi lilelile

reason.en: Also named after the spirit Mwanga
reason.sw: Nao umepewa jina la pepo Mwanga
Umepewa jina la pepo hao hao
